test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08fc7f2efa36dc337d44c02ee7aebcfc0e5967774242a87ba6228cc2f97c6758.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**'1' is present in dice number one, by keeping the '1' constant in 1st and 4th dice.**

We get the face opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a9ad24475c888c9e4076a4f9f47f1b3f9d68134ed2858875e7c0ea68a989726.png] 

We can get that **6 **is the opposite to 5.<
